title: Register drops supabase_user_id
evidence: UserCreate schema omits supabase_user_id field; AuthService._create_local_user passes it via UserCreate(...) and Pydantic silently drops it leaving local row with NULL supabase_user_id (breaks subsequent lookups by Supabase id)
recommendation: Add supabase_user_id: UUID | None = None to UserCreate; or refactor _create_local_user to set the attribute on the ORM model after .create()

title: Detailed health Redis check broken
evidence: Health route calls redis_client.ping() but RedisClient class exposes only initialize/get_connection/publish/subscribe/etc — no ping method — so detailed health always reports redis as unhealthy
recommendation: Either add ping() that calls (await self.get_connection()).ping() or change the health check to use get_connection().ping() directly

title: Reconciliation routes reference undefined EventType
evidence: Routes emit WebSocketEvent(event_type=EventType.ACCOUNT_RECONCILED) but EventType enum has no ACCOUNT_RECONCILED member; AttributeError raised inside try/except converts to 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR for every reconcile call
recommendation: Add ACCOUNT_RECONCILED (and any other missing members like ACCOUNTS_RECONCILED) to app/websocket/events.EventType
